description: Shared cross-language test vectors for the ato.execution-contract/v1 canonical form. Consumed by crates/capsule/tests/execution_contract_vectors.rs and reusable verbatim by ato-api.
numbers: v1 contracts contain only integer numbers: the sole JSON number is guest_surface.port, a nonzero integer in 1..=65535 (0 is rejected fail-closed). No fractional or exponent literals ever appear in a valid contract, so implementations face no RFC 8785 number-serialization ambiguity beyond small integers.
optional_fields: Optional identity fields (target.libc, target.observable_features, guest_surface.port, and every optional collection: dependencies, build_outputs, launch.environment, launch.secret_bindings, filesystem.writable_paths, guest_surface.features, external_state) have exactly one canonical spelling for absence: the key is omitted from the JSON entirely. Explicit null and explicit-empty collections ({} / []) are non-canonical spellings of absence and MUST be rejected before hashing; implementations must never silently normalize them to the omitted form, or semantically identical input would derive different execution_ids across languages. Pinned by the invalid-null-* and invalid-empty-* vectors.
opaque_digests: The opaque sub-contract digest fields (source.projection_digest, runtime.dynamic_contract_digest, build_outputs[].projection_digest, launch.process_model_digest, launch.environment_policy_digest, launch.environment[].value_digest, filesystem.topology_digest, policy.network_digest, policy.capability_digest, policy.filesystem_digest) are ALWAYS blake3: their preimage is fixed by v1 as blake3(UTF8(domain) || 0x00 || JCS(payload)) under one of the frozen domains ato.source-projection-contract/v1, ato.runtime-dynamic-contract/v1, ato.build-output-projection/v1, ato.process-model-contract/v1, ato.environment-policy/v1, ato.environment-value/v1, ato.filesystem-topology/v1, ato.network-policy/v1, ato.capability-policy/v1, ato.filesystem-policy/v1. The algorithm is not a producer choice: a sha256-spelled value is NOT a valid opaque sub-contract digest and MUST be rejected before hashing. Only the payload schema behind each digest is versioned separately from v1 (RFC 4.5); the algorithm, domain, and preimage rule are frozen. Pinned by the invalid-sha256-*-digest vectors.
guest_path_ordering: Guest-path lists (filesystem.writable_paths) are sorted segment-wise, and WITHIN each segment by UTF-8 byte lexicographic order (equivalently Unicode code-point order). TypeScript implementations MUST compare UTF-8 bytes, NOT UTF-16 code units — the two orders diverge for astral-plane characters: e.g. U+E000 precedes U+10000 by UTF-8/code point, but follows it by UTF-16 (the astral char's lead surrogate U+D800 sorts before the single unit U+E000). Guest paths also reject every Unicode control character (char::is_control: the C0 range incl. NUL, DEL, and the C1 range U+0080..U+009F), not only C0/DEL. Pinned by guest-path-utf8-order (valid, correctly ordered), invalid-guest-path-utf16-order (same pair reversed into UTF-16 order), and invalid-c1-control-target (U+0085 NEL).

vectors.name: field-order
vectors.notes: same contract with every object's keys reverse-sorted; JCS erases key order

vectors.name: whitespace
vectors.notes: same contract minified; input whitespace never reaches the canonical form

vectors.name: unicode-strings
vectors.notes: pins RFC 8785 string canonicalization for free-form fields: input escapes (surrogate pair, control chars) and literal UTF-8 (é-acute, CJK, kana, astral-plane emoji) canonicalize identically — control characters as lowercase \u00xx / two-char escapes, everything else as literal UTF-8

vectors.name: mutate-source-projection-digest
vectors.notes: opaque source projection-rules sub-contract digest is identity-bearing (RFC §4.2 Source)

vectors.name: mutate-target-observable-features
vectors.notes: baseline omits observable_features entirely; introducing one changes the id

vectors.name: mutate-runtime-dynamic-contract-digest
vectors.notes: opaque dynamic-runtime sub-contract digest is identity-bearing (RFC §4.2 Runtime)

vectors.name: mutate-build-output-projection-digest

vectors.name: mutate-launch-process-model-digest

vectors.name: mutate-launch-environment-policy-digest

vectors.name: mutate-filesystem-topology-digest
vectors.notes: opaque mount-topology and access-modes sub-contract digest is identity-bearing (RFC §4.2 Filesystem)

vectors.name: mutate-network-policy-digest
vectors.notes: opaque network-policy sub-contract digest is identity-bearing (RFC §4.2 Network; domain ato.network-policy/v1)

vectors.name: mutate-capability-policy-digest

vectors.name: mutate-filesystem-policy-digest
vectors.notes: opaque filesystem-policy sub-contract digest is identity-bearing (RFC §4.2 Capabilities; domain ato.filesystem-policy/v1)

vectors.name: guest-path-utf8-order
vectors.notes: GuestPath lists sort segment-wise by UTF-8 byte order: U+E000 precedes U+10000 under UTF-8/code-point order (they invert under UTF-16). This correctly-ordered pair is accepted; TypeScript implementations MUST compare UTF-8 bytes, not UTF-16 code units. See invalid-guest-path-utf16-order for the rejected reverse.

vectors.name: envelope-non-identity
vectors.notes: provenance/diagnostics/evidence/timestamps/runner/session/snapshot/host facts are non-identity and ignored

vectors.name: source-kind-alias
vectors.notes: source.kind is a non-identity resolved-ref alias; it must not change the id

vectors.name: source-immutable-ref-alias
vectors.notes: source.immutable_ref is a non-identity resolved-ref alias; it must not change the id

vectors.name: runtime-resolved-ref-alias
vectors.notes: runtime.resolved_ref is a non-identity resolved-ref alias; it must not change the id

vectors.name: envelope-execution-id-mismatch
vectors.notes: stored execution_id disagrees with the canonical hash; readers fail closed

vectors.name: invalid-unknown-identity-field
vectors.notes: unknown top-level identity-bearing field fails closed

vectors.name: invalid-unknown-nested-identity-field
vectors.notes: unknown nested identity-bearing field fails closed

vectors.name: invalid-schema-version
vectors.notes: contract version mismatch fails closed

vectors.name: invalid-placeholder-digest
vectors.notes: placeholder digest values are rejected before an id is issued

vectors.name: invalid-uppercase-digest
vectors.notes: uppercase hex is non-canonical and rejected

vectors.name: invalid-unsorted-dependencies
vectors.notes: identity lists must be pre-sorted and duplicate-free

vectors.name: invalid-empty-argv
vectors.notes: unresolved launch argv fails closed

vectors.name: invalid-null-libc
vectors.notes: explicit null is a non-canonical spelling of an absent target.libc; only key omission is canonical

vectors.name: invalid-null-port
vectors.notes: explicit null is a non-canonical spelling of an absent guest_surface.port; only key omission is canonical

vectors.name: invalid-empty-build-outputs

vectors.name: invalid-empty-environment

vectors.name: invalid-empty-writable-paths

vectors.name: invalid-empty-features

vectors.name: invalid-empty-external-state

vectors.name: invalid-empty-readonly-layers
vectors.notes: filesystem.readonly_layers is REQUIRED and non-empty: an execution with no immutable layer has no filesystem to identify

vectors.name: invalid-relative-cwd
vectors.notes: a relative launch.cwd is not a canonical guest path (must be absolute)

vectors.name: invalid-dotdot-target
vectors.notes: a '..' segment in external_state[].target is not a canonical guest path

vectors.name: invalid-trailing-slash-target
vectors.notes: a trailing slash in external_state[].target is not a canonical guest path

vectors.name: invalid-zero-port
vectors.notes: guest_surface.port 0 is never a valid declared surface and is rejected (NonZeroU16)

vectors.name: invalid-guest-path-utf16-order
vectors.notes: filesystem.writable_paths sorted by UTF-16 code units is non-canonical: U+10000 before U+E000 is the reverse of the normative UTF-8 byte order (see guest-path-utf8-order)

vectors.name: invalid-c1-control-target
vectors.notes: a C1 control character (U+0085 NEL) in external_state[].target is not a canonical guest path: all Unicode control characters are rejected, not only C0/DEL

vectors.name: invalid-duplicate-top-level-field
vectors.notes: a duplicate top-level key (last-wins) is rejected by the struct deserializer

vectors.name: invalid-duplicate-nested-field
vectors.notes: a duplicate key inside a nested identity object is rejected by the struct deserializer

vectors.name: invalid-duplicate-observable-feature
vectors.notes: a duplicate observable-feature map key (BTreeMap last-wins) is rejected by the unique-map visitor
